business_problem: Barré Technologies wanted to help customers handle labor-intensive document and process-management work such as invoice processing, repository navigation, and data lookups without relying on scarce specialist staff or exposing sensitive information to insecure AI deployments.
solution_summary: Barré Technologies built an AI assistant on the IBM watsonx portfolio to sit inside enterprise document-management and business-process environments. The company already had expertise with IBM FileNet and IBM Cloud Pak for Data, and used IBM watsonx.ai to add natural-language assistance that can query application data in the background and return curated results quickly. The architecture supports invoice ingestion and processing, navigation of regulatory repositories, and navigation of internal business knowledge bases. Barré selected deployable LLMs with Central and Eastern Europe language support, including Mistral and Llama 3, so the assistant could run on premises for clients that handle highly sensitive or regulated data. In practice, the assistant can validate invoice details against internal and external sources, post results into ERP workflows, and surface the right documents inside existing applications, giving users faster access to the information and actions they need.

solution_components.name: IBM FileNet
solution_components.role: Acts as one of the enterprise document-management systems the assistant connects to and augments.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Pak for Data
solution_components.role: Supports the enterprise data environment that the assistant queries in the background.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx
solution_components.role: Provides the foundation for Barré's AI assistant and its integration with IBM and third-party applications.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Hosts the language-model capabilities used for natural-language querying and guided document workflows.

solution_components.name: Mistral
solution_components.role: Supplies one of the on-premises-capable language models used for Central and Eastern Europe language support.

solution_components.name: Llama 3
solution_components.role: Provides an alternative language model for the assistant's natural-language workflows.

data_flow: Users ask natural-language questions inside document-management or process-management applications, the assistant queries enterprise content and process data from FileNet and Cloud Pak for Data, validates invoice information against internal and external sources, and then returns curated results or posts outcomes into downstream ERP workflows.
business_outcome: Barré improved enterprise-application navigation and document handling, generated measurable productivity gains in its own client-zero use, and built a secure on-premises AI assistant it can roll out to regulated customers in Hungary.
